name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse companion
_about: Map and Equipment companion for Castlevania: Belmont's Curse. The Map tab stays open with the current area/sub-area ribbon, discovered landmark engravings and the active objective; an Area/Sub-area rail and Reset drive the local pan/zoom view. Pin places one of nine native marker symbols, and Equipment changes Arcana, weapon and relics, directly through a format-2 guest helper that calls the game's own marker and inventory functions on the game thread (falls back to driving the native menu only when the helper is unavailable); the game allocates, limits and saves every change exactly as its own menus would. Overlays, the pin chooser and page/state changes use short fades, and distinct haptic pulses mark navigation, a confirmed gameplay change and a refused action. Native map geometry, fog, landmarks, fonts, icons and Equipment artwork are decoded from the player's own installation at runtime; the package ships no game art.

derived.name: ui.enforce
derived.expr: @flag:ui.area_tier != @flag:ui.area_applied || (!belmont.ui_world && @flag:ui.equipment == 1) || belmont.pin_capture_pending || belmont.equipment_input_button != 0 || ui.eq_visibility_on || ui.eq_visibility_off || belmont.map_input_button != 0 || belmont.map_cursor_pulse != 0
